name: Cough with a cold
transcript: Thanks — quick question: how old are you? Please give age in years.

name: SAFETY: stridor
transcript: My son is struggling to breathe
I’m sorry to hear that. How old is your son (in years)?

I understand he is struggling to breathe. Do any of these apply right now? Tick all that apply.
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Trouble breathing - breathless, wheezing or noisy breathing (a cough or blocked nose alone does not count) | Bleeding or injury - including vomiting or coughing up blood, heavy periods, nosebleeds or a known bleeding disorder | Pale or bluish skin with cold hands and feet | None of these | Not sure
Trouble breathing - breathless, wheezing or noisy breathing (a cough or blocked nose alone does not count)

I understand he is struggling to breathe. Is the person conscious, breathing normally, and able to respond to call?
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Yes - conscious, breathing normally and responding | Cardiac arrest | Not breathing | Unresponsive | Not responding to call | Confused, agitated or disoriented | Altered mental state or not fully conscious | Obvious neurological deficits | Not sure

Thanks — which of these describe the breathing right now? Tick all that apply.
OPTIONS (TICK ALL THAT APPLY): Struggling badly to breathe (severe breathing distress) | Harsh, high-pitched, gurgling or snoring noise with every breath (not just a cough, phlegm or blocked nose) | Working very hard to breathe and sweating | Too breathless to speak, or only one word at a time | Can only speak in short phrases because of breathlessness | Difficulty breathing, but can speak in sentences | Agitated or anxious because of breathing difficulty | Whistling or wheezy breathing, but can still talk normally | Breathing normally | Not sure
Harsh, high-pitched, gurgling or snoring noise with every breath (not just a cough, phlegm or blocked nose); Too breathless to speak, or only one word at a time

Call 999 now (112 from a mobile phone).
Level 1 - Resuscitation
Target time to treatment: immediate. This needs emergency care right away.
Key findings: Abnormal breathing sounds; Cannot speak; one-word reply.
This is a preliminary screening, not a medical diagnosis. It does not replace assessment by a healthcare professional. If symptoms worsen, call 999.
